notes: Real clip (window 2.7-3.87 s): level garage lane, horizon / tube vanishing point at ~(50%, 51%), camera ~0.5 m high, slow straight dolly-in down the lane centre, lens ~25 mm equivalent. Coupe BROADSIDE across the lane, nose frame-left, centred: spans 32.4-65.8% of frame width at the window start (33.4%) and 30.2-67.9% at the end (37.7%), i.e. +13% growth; roof at ~40% frame height, tyre bottom ~56.5%, wheel centres 39.5/59.1% growing to 37.9/60.2%. Two rows of steadily lit fluorescent tubes (6+ per side) converge on the VP; orange-tinted columns at the extreme left/right edges roughly at the car's depth, farther columns at ~29% either side of centre; hazy back wall. REFIT v2 (after verifier): the first fit sized the car for its centreline distance (9.2 -> 7.9 m) but the near flank is 0.88 m closer, so the car came out 12-18% too large and grew +18.7% (real +13%). Fix: car pushed away from the camera, car_pos y -9.5 -> -8.4 (car_pos [-0.1,-8.4,0], car_yaw 90 = nose toward -X = frame left), dolly shortened from 1.3 m to 1.08 m (cam y -18.7 -> -17.62, was -17.4); cam x=0, z=0.48 constant, level aim (look_at 58.7 m down the lane at the same height), lens 25 mm. Near-flank distance 9.42 m -> 8.34 m (ratio +12.9%, real +13%). Measured on 1280x720 renders (diff mask of the render with and without the car): car spans 32.9-66.1% (33.2%) at the start and 30.8-68.2% (37.4%) at the end (real 33.4% / 37.7%; nose/tail errors 0.5/0.3 % at the start and 0.6/0.3 % at the end), growth +12.7% (real +13%); projected wheel centres 39.1/59.6% -> 37.7/60.8% (real 39.5/59.1 -> 37.9/60.2, errors <= 0.6%), cabin roof top 40.6% -> 39.3% (real ~40.0%), tyre bottom 56.1-56.9% (real ~56.5%); horizon at 50% (real VP 51%, left level on purpose because tilting to 51% moves roof and tyres off their measured rows); orientation (nose left) and dolly direction match; garage environment type, column rows at the frame edges and the tube pair at the top corners as before; 29 frames, no continuity spike. OPEN MISMATCHES (not expressible with previs params, see builder_requests): (1) the RECIPES flicker keeps the +-3.5 m ceiling tubes dark at the start of the window and lights them over the shot, whereas the real tubes are steadily bright from frame 0 (needs a lights_on / flicker:false override, or a per-shot flicker key); (2) the car body shares one grey with the columns/beams/walls so its silhouette is low-contrast (needs a car_grey or structure_grey option); (3) the 0.56 m beam slab at 21-27% height (beam row at y=-8) and the parking-bay lines that run through the wheel positions under the broadside car are heavier than the real thin conduit / bare floor (needs beams / bay_lines options); (4) the builder's rear wing is taller than the cabin roof (top of the end plates ~37.6% vs the roof at 40.6%), whereas the real spoiler sits below the roof line.
